target_customer: Mexican online sellers on Mercado Libre, Amazon and Shopify who need working capital
problem: Online sellers cannot get bank loans and need stock financing. Creizer lends against store sales and is repaid as a share of sales.
business_model: Lender: revenue based financing, credit lines and fixed loans with interest and fees
product_category: Revenue based financing for e-commerce sellers

founders.name: Emiliano Musalem
previous_startups: data analytics tool for SMEs (co-founder, unnamed)

competitors.name: Clearco (Clearbanc)
competitors.what: revenue based financing for online sellers; the model Creizer copies for LATAM

competitors.name: Fairplay
competitors.what: revenue based financing for online businesses in Mexico
competitors.funding_then: 35 million dollars equity and debt, Jan 2022

competitors.name: Divibank
competitors.what: Brazilian Clearbanc of LATAM for e-commerce and SaaS

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting store APIs and scoring sales is standard engineering; the hard part is capital and credit risk, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: Underwriting data from marketplaces could compound, but Fairplay and Clearco copied the same model and capital access decides winners.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Fairplay raised 35 million dollars in January 2022; a secondary analysis names Mercado Crédito and Konfío as rivals. No acquisition of Creizer found.

market_need_then: Mexican e-commerce sellers lacked bank credit and the Clearco model was spreading across LATAM, with Fairplay and Divibank raising in 2021 and 2022.

identity.voice_and_tone: Spanish language lender copy: no fees, funds in 48 hours, does not pause listings on default

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand; the name resembles Creze and similar and is easy to misspell.

outcome_analysis: Creizer copied the Clearco model for Mexican online sellers and joined YC in Winter 2022 with a small team. Public funding data is thin, a seed from Carabela in 2021 and unverified aggregate totals near 500K. Its site now shows three credit products and aggregators claim hundreds of sellers, but there is no reliable growth data, so its trajectory is unclear.
notes: Unverified: total funding of 500K to 525K and a 0.5M convertible note on 2022-04-01 with YC come only from aggregators (CB Insights, extruct). Revenue of 2.9M in 2024 and 500+ sellers are from aggregators. The Carabela seed amount was not seen. The Clearco competitor entry relies on the YC page text (undated) for the model reference. One outcome search returned no results about Creizer.
